explication: LangChain4j is a Java library for building LLM-powered applications, with unified APIs and ready-to-use provider integrations. A typical user flow sends a message through a chat model, optionally using memory, tools, or agents, and returns an application response. For RAG, documents can be ingested and retrieved with embedding models and stores. The README documents these broad capabilities; sampled sources specifically confirm query routing and web-search contracts, but not the full runtime wiring, so those broader links cite the README.
